systems.system: Database of persons prosecuted and convicted by the criminal courts
systems.country_label: database of information on persons who have been prosecuted and convicted by the criminal courts
systems.owner: Directorate General of Prisons and Rehabilitation Centres for Minors, Ministry of Justice, Worship and Prisons
systems.tiers: an aim of the directorate's action plan for fiscal year 2022; the report does not say it was built

note: No fact: the state's UPR report names the National Police and gendarmerie only for human rights training (200 officers in 2021), inspections of 10 police holding facilities and gendarmerie stations in 2019-2021, and four trafficking cases referred by the criminal investigation brigade. It states nothing on how stations record reports or cases. The one system near the field is the prisons directorate's planned 2022 database of convicted persons; a planned referral and case management system for gender-based violence (2024 workshop, Ministry of Social Affairs) is outside the police.
